author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Zyxel fixed a critical flaw in multiple routers that lets unauthenticated attackers remotely execute commands on vulnerable devices. Zyxel addressed a critical remote code execution vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2025-13942 (CVSS score of 9.8), affecting more than a dozen router models. A command injection flaw in the UPnP feature of several Zyxel CPEs, Fiber ONTs, and […]
title: Critical Zyxel router flaw exposed devices to remote attacks

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: ShinyHunters leaked data from 12.4M CarGurus accounts, exposing personal information from the U.S.-based auto research and shopping platform. The ShinyHunters group published personal data from over 12 million CarGurus accounts. title: ShinyHunters cyberattack on CarGurus impacts 12.4 Million users

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: A former employee at U.S. defense contractor L3Harris got over 7 years in prison for selling eight zero-days to a Russian broker. title: Former U.S. Defense contractor executive sentenced for selling zero-day exploits to Russian broker Operation Zero
